feature_request: Add webhook support to event system with retry logic and endpoint registration API

decisions.decision: Merge featureDev defaults into existing config
decisions.rationale: Config file exists at .claude/refactor.config.json but lacks featureDev section. Per skill spec, missing fields use defaults silently.
Per skill spec: lowercase, replace spaces and special characters with hyphens, truncate to 40 characters. Result is 39 chars, no truncation needed.

Skill spec explicitly states: 'All agents are spawned on-demand when their phase begins -- not upfront. This avoids wasting resources if the user abandons after elicitation.' Phase 0.2 only defines the Task Discovery Protocol template for later use.

User provided: core problem statement, 3 specific event types, existence of event bus in src/events/, need for retry logic, need for registration API. Missing: scope boundaries, retry specifics, registration granularity, auth model, URL validation, performance constraints.

decisions.decision: Ask 6 focused questions (medium confidence band: 4-8 questions)
decisions.rationale: Graduated elicitation rule: medium confidence (50-79%) should ask 4-8 focused questions organized by dimension. 6 questions selected covering: scope boundaries (1), acceptance criteria (1), user-facing behavior (2), edge cases (1), constraints (1). Design/implementation questions deferred to Phase 4 architecture.
